title: test_editor_preview's _clear_generated() on a runtime instance frees ConnectController._preview, leaving a dangling reference a later draw gesture would dereference
evidence:
tests/test_editor_preview.gd:41-43:
	# The editor path: clear + regenerate (the button's exact body, via the
	# shared helpers) — must reproduce the boot world IDENTICALLY.
	scene._clear_generated()

scripts/connect_controller.gd:38:
	pipes_container.add_child(_preview)

scripts/main.gd:163-166:
	for container: Node3D in [nodes_container, pipes_container]:
		for c in container.get_children():
			container.remove_child(c)
			c.free()

scripts/connect_controller.gd:49:
	_preview.visible = false # shown on the first projected move — never a stale arc
detail: The test calls _clear_generated() on a live runtime scene; it frees every child of Pipes, including the controller's preview arc added at _ready. Verified headless: after clear, is_instance_valid(controller._preview) == false and draw_begin errors on a 'previously freed' instance. The shipped editor path is safe only because non-@tool ConnectController never runs _ready under the editor hint; nothing in _clear_generated, the controller, or the test guards the dangling reference.
recommended_fix: Guard draw_begin/draw_move with is_instance_valid(_preview) and rebuild the preview when freed, or have _clear_generated skip/exclude foreign children it does not own (e.g., track generated children).
